lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: On an isolated copy fail feature/outbox and photo/signature writes; Save, Back, camera, rotate and recover before retry.
Fail track insert during recording and Stop, then restore storage; kill process and reboot with an unwritten tail in the same and another project.
Fail backup, mutate a layer after backup and attempt final deletion; check Undo and preserved rows/photos.
Trigger dataSync timeout, cancellation and permission revoke; verify worker exit and lease release without ANR or data deletion.
Export LayerBackup and complete administrator recovery only on a copy following incident-and-rollback.
value.expected: Failed Save/Stop cannot report completion or discard pending work; retry is ordered and idempotent; backup and project gates remain fail-closed.
